description: Autonomous headless QA loop for Project Aegis: generate scenarios of escalating complexity (mission type, platform mix, victory conditions, events, ROE, EMCON) grounded in the platform catalog DB, run them through the batch sim harness, and remediate every defect via TDD. Runs a fixed 5-tier ladder unattended, commits fixes to a QA branch, and delivers a full AAR. Use when the user runs /qa-gauntlet, or asks for "QA gauntlet", "escalating complexity QA", "tiered scenario stress test", "autonomous sim QA loop", "batch sim defect remediation", or "gauntlet AAR".
